prompt: Build an eccentric disk cam with a flat translating follower. The cam rotates about +Y with eccentricity 4 mm and radius 10 mm; the follower face is perpendicular to +X and moves along X. Measure the follower lift at 0/90/180/270/360 degrees and confirm the three parts are separate and collision-free.
notes: A flat-face follower on an eccentric circular cam has lift x = R + e*cos(theta) + gap; this is a sampled profile, not continuous contact.
Collision is checked at the five sampled angles only; no spring, friction, load, wear or physical function.
The follower is positioned by the source at each commanded angle; a static source must fail.
